status: Designer-specified implementation targets under the approved visual direction; not measured pixel values or native-app acceptance evidence.

units.font: reference points; no user text-scale system required
units.colors: sRGB hex, opaque unless otherwise specified

appearance.scope: Simple local appearance; optional existing system/Deep Indigo accent choice. No advanced editor or portable preference contract.

typography.money_shrink_to_fit: forbidden; reflow or scroll the containing layout

table.row_height_policy: Reference minima for composition, not a user density preference; grow for actual content and wrapped descriptions
table.horizontal_scroll: available when full column set cannot fit; amount must not wrap

layout.responsive_policy: Content fit: close inspector first; prefer an icon-only navigation rail; hide navigation only if even the rail materially harms content; retain labelled navigation/details controls

state_rules.selected: tint plus selection semantics; distinct from keyboard focus
state_rules.disabled: unavailable action remains identifiable; give a reason when consequential
state_rules.loading: neutral placeholder; never fabricated financial values
state_rules.error: specific cause and allowed next action; saved versus not saved remains explicit
state_rules.missing: em dash or specific missing-input explanation, not zero
state_rules.semantic_color: derived from authoritative financial meaning, never solely from sign or text parsing
